item.title: Pretty setting! Almost three acres in Virginia. $129,900
item.description: This house has a pretty setting! If you pull up street view, it looks like a quiet country road. Big old trees on the lot. The house was built in 1950. It is located on 2.83 acres in Long Island, Virginia. The house could use some work, but it looks livable. I would do a thorough cleaning and work room by room. There is an outbuilding on the property. Three bedrooms, two bathrooms and 1,176 square feet. $129,900 Contact Charlie Watts with Watts Auction Realty: 434-942-0840 From the Zillow listin

item.title: Pretty floors! Pretty staircase! C. 1920 in Oklahoma. $255,000
item.description: This house has pretty wood floors! Nice staircase too! The house was built in 1920. It is located in El Reno, Oklahoma. The house features a wrap around front porch, pretty staircase, beautiful wood floors, picture rails, spacious kitchen and some great bathrooms. The house has an attached garage. item.title: Pretty yard and view! C. 1951. Over an acre in Oregon. $399,900
item.description: Love this yard! Pretty landscaping! Great views too! The house was built in 1951. It is located on 1.16 acres in Roseburg, Oregon. The house features a front porch, pretty landscaping, stone walkways, wood floors, brick hearth, built-ins and a sunroom. There is an attached two car garage. Four bedrooms, three bathrooms and 3,069 square feet. $399,900 Contact Jennifer Kramer with RE/MAX Integrity: 541-580-6767 From the Zillow listing: Mid-century modern gem on 1.16 acres with breathtaking views o

item.title: Pretty details! Circa 1920. Over two acres in Pennsylvania. $790,000
item.description: This house has a lot of pretty details! The house was built in 1920. It is located on 2.17 acres in Conshohocken, Pennsylvania. The house features custom tile flooring, stone fireplace, built-in corner china cabinets, crown moulding, wood floors, exposed beams and multiple patios. The home sits about Gulph Creek. Five bedrooms, five bathrooms and 4,089 square feet. $790,000 Contact Marion Dinofa with Compass Real Estate: 610-914-1144 From the Zillow listing: Unique and jaw-dropping Revolution-er

item.title: Deal of the Day! Circa 1905 in Tennessee. $84,900
item.description: This deal of the day has some nice details and woodwork! The house was built in 1905. It is located on .48 acre in Dyersburg, Tennessee. The house features a covered front porch, wood floors, chair rails, pocket doors, crystal chandelier, wide baseboards, chair rails, transom windows and a claw foot tub. Two bedrooms, two bathrooms and 1,495 square feet. $84,900 Contact Gina Miller with The Gina Miller Realty Company: 573-344-9225 From the Zillow listing: JUST REDUCED!!! Home Has Approx 2336 Sq

item.title: Almost six acres in the foothills of the NC mountains. C. 1947. $225,000
item.description: This is a pretty area of North Carolina. Nice acreage with this house! The home was built in 1947. It is located on 5.72 acres in Marion, North Carolina. The house features a covered front porch, an enclosed back porch, wood floors, stone fireplace, baseboards and an unfinished second floor. There is a detached carport with storage shed on the property. Three bedrooms, one bathroom and 1,212 square feet. $225,000 Contact Brandon Braswell with Realty Group: 828homesales@gmail.com From the Zillow

item.title: Fixer Upper Alert! Circa 1880’s in Virginia. $140,000
item.description: Fixer Upper Alert! This house has potential! They probably need to come down on that price some. Or someone could make a much lower offer. The house was built sometime in the 1880’s. It is located on .3 acre in Crewe, Virginia. The house features a covered front porch, some original wood floors, pretty mantels, nice staircase, double front doors, crown moulding, wide baseboards and a claw foot tub. There is a detached storage shed/workshop on the property. Four bedrooms, two bathrooms and 2,393

item.title: Sweet house overlooking the town! C. 1910 in Vermont. $249,500
item.description: This is a sweet house overlooking the town! Could easily live there and work room by room. The house was built in 1910. It is located in Montpelier, Vermont. The house features double back porches, wood floors, crown moulding, baseboards and a basement. Three bedrooms, one bathroom and 1,112 square feet. $249,500 Contact Lucy Ferrada with Heney Realtors: 802-279-7735 From the Zillow listing: Perched on a hill with views overlooking the city, this three-bedroom home offers a wonderful opportunity

item.title: Fixer Upper Alert! C. 1920. Almost an acre in West Virginia. $135,900
item.description: Fixer Upper Alert! This house has a lot of potential! It’s a big house with over 4,000 square feet. The house was built in 1920. It is located on .89 acre in Huntington, West Virginia. By looking at third floor pictures, the roof probably needs some attention. The house features a covered back porch, wood floors, built-in shelving, crown moulding, wainscoting and a spacious kitchen. Six bedrooms, four bathrooms and 4,592 square feet. $135,900 Contact Michael M. Moore with Runyan and Associates R
